instruction: Summarize the meeting in 3 bullet points focused on decisions and action items.
reference_summary:
- Decision: ship the public REST API and a dashboard performance pass in Q2; rate limiting (429) is part of API v1.
- The Slack integration moves to the Q3 backlog and the full dashboard redesign is parked until usage data is available.
- Action items: Marcus scopes the API and perf pass by Monday; Ken drafts API docs; Sofia writes redesign findings for the Q3 brief; Priya updates the roadmap and informs sales.
key_points: Ship public REST API in Q2
Dashboard performance pass instead of full redesign
Rate limiting included in API v1 scope
Full redesign parked pending usage data
Action items assigned to Marcus, Ken, Sofia, Priya

reference_summary: Verdant Foods is a Portland-based organic food manufacturer founded in 2009, with 1,150 employees and USD 310M in FY2024 revenue. It produces organic packaged foods distributed to North American grocery chains and is USDA Organic and B-Corp certified.
